author: WebBound
description: xsw.tw (台灣小說網): info page -> /book/<id>/ TOC. Chapter text is AES-128-CBC ciphertext in the page (var encrypted/key/iv) and is decrypted with crypto.subtle. extractMetadata reads title/author from the Big5 TOC page when the extension garbles the UTF-8 info page (stale big5 meta), else defers to the selectors.
